name: My renderer (any tool that ends in a video file)
kind: any: manim, motion-canvas, revideo, blender, ffmpeg filter graphs, After Effects (aerender), Unity, a web recorder ...
install: how the user installs it (the setup skill runs this with them)
agentSkills: optional: the tool's own agent skills or docs the assistant should read first
scaffold: how a new project/scene is created
stills: optional: how to export a few frames for review
notes: Copy this file to .vidbucks/renderers/<id>.json, then: node bin/vidbucks.mjs config set renderers remotion,custom:<id>
